transport.websocket: one IRC message per frame; no trailing frame bytes

vendor.onyx/e2ee: permits the +onyx/e2ee message tag and E2EEGROUP eligibility

server.group_control_semantics: authenticated membership policy and opaque E2EEGROUP control-record delivery are live, including mesh hop custody and exact-once replay metadata
server.local_authoring_quiesce: operator-only E2EEGROUP ON|OFF|STATUS; inbound relay, ACK, and retry stay live while quiesced

client.group_crypto_semantics: OGC1 sign/parse/verify helpers exist; live store send/open, trusted-directory verify, and room-key install are not product-wired

authenticated_no_reusable_session.negotiation: FAIL E2EEGROUP SESSION_UNAVAILABLE; connection closes before autojoin or further participation
authenticated_no_reusable_session.authoring_defense: WARN E2EEGROUP TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE; a reusable session is required for group E2EE

resume.invariant: A successful same-account resume preserves the logical attachment without duplicate JOIN or MODE events.
resume.detached_ghost: restore snapshot then replace the ghost; the token remains reusable
resume.mesh_token: non-local-length hex is a mesh-sealed reclaim credential, not a one-shot replay nonce

replay_live_separation.live_commands: processLiveLine is the only client-command admission path
replay_live_separation.history_replay: CHATHISTORY and bouncer rewind replay stored events; they do not re-author live commands
replay_live_separation.helix_e2ee_group: EGRG Helix checkpoints are replay metadata only; opaque payloads and hop-custody wires never enter Helix
replay_live_separation.session_resume: snapshot or live-sibling attach; original JOIN/PART/QUIT live commands are not replayed

e2ee_group.message_tag_semantics: internal MLS-family marker only; does not claim RFC 9420 wire interoperability

trusted_signer.semantics: verification requires an externally supplied trusted Ed25519 public key; the wire signer_pub must equal that key and is never account authentication by itself

delivery.recipient_gate: onyx/e2ee negotiated, locally joined to the channel, and attached to a reusable session
delivery.welcome_absence: explicit TARGET_UNAVAILABLE failure; no offline-recipient persistence

quit.client_visible: one identity-wide QUIT; per-channel membership withdrawals converge separately

part.channels: comma-separated list with a shared reason
part.intent: one-way exact-token withdrawal of the named channels only
